IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with a sleek
black bob and blunt bangs wears a
taupe cropped long-sleeve cardigan with
a graphic print and small buttons over a
dark bralette. A black choker sits at her
throat, and a black leather shoulder bag
hangs at one side. Wide brown
parachute cargo trousers with a
drawstring and a studded belt complete
the look. Chunky black platform slides
finish the outfit. Her expression is calm
and direct. Soft, even studio light.
Palette of taupe, chocolate, and black.
Relaxed and utilitarian, in the style of a
streetwear catalog.
